info.title: Venticinque e ventuno
info.synopsis: Kim Tae-ri (“Mr. Sunshine”) e Nam Joo-hyuk (“Start-Up”) si tuffano negli anni ’90 in questa serie romantica sui grandi sogni e sulle problematiche della crescita.

seasons.plot: The dreams of two young people are crushed by an overwhelming financial crisis in the 1990s. But when they reunite at the ages of 25 and 21, the spirited pair finds friendship and affection in times of adversity as they venture into adulthood together.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.plot: When the IMF financial crisis threatens to slash Na Hee-do's dreams, she sets out to get herself transferred to another school with a fencing program.

translations.value: When the IMF financial crisis threatens to slash Na Hee-do's dreams, she sets out to get herself transferred to another school with a fencing program.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.plot: Though taken aback by Ko Yu-rim's cold attitude, Hee-do gives it her best in their first face-off. More of Back Yi-jin's situation comes into focus.

translations.value: Though taken aback by Ko Yu-rim's cold attitude, Hee-do gives it her best in their first face-off. More of Back Yi-jin's situation comes into focus.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.plot: When a fortuitous opportunity presents itself, Hee-do begs her coach for extra training. An unanticipated visitor comes around hoping to see Yi-jin.

translations.value: When a fortuitous opportunity presents itself, Hee-do begs her coach for extra training. An unanticipated visitor comes around hoping to see Yi-jin.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.plot: In exchange for a favor, Hee-do carries out a daily errand for Moon Ji-woong. She happens across a drunk Yi-jin after he fails another job interview.

translations.value: In exchange for a favor, Hee-do carries out a daily errand for Moon Ji-woong. She happens across a drunk Yi-jin after he fails another job interview.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.plot: Hee-do takes one giant leap closer to her dream. She's eager to tell Yi-jin the good news — but realizes he's disappeared without a trace.

translations.value: Hee-do takes one giant leap closer to her dream. She's eager to tell Yi-jin the good news — but realizes he's disappeared without a trace.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.plot: Tensions run high between Hee-do and Yu-rim before an important event. Yi-jin takes on a new assignment, and spots a familiar face in the crowd.

translations.value: Tensions run high between Hee-do and Yu-rim before an important event. Yi-jin takes on a new assignment, and spots a familiar face in the crowd.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.plot: A frustrating media narrative dampens a monumental moment for Hee-do. Yi-jin chases down the only person who may be able to set things right.

translations.value: A frustrating media narrative dampens a monumental moment for Hee-do. Yi-jin chases down the only person who may be able to set things right.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.plot: Hee-do perceives a growing distance between herself and Yi-jin, even as he moves back into the neighborhood. Trouble at home adds to Yu-rim's stress.

translations.value: Hee-do perceives a growing distance between herself and Yi-jin, even as he moves back into the neighborhood. Trouble at home adds to Yu-rim's stress.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.plot: As Yu-rim's perspective on Hee-do shifts, so does her behavior. While Hee-do avoids seeing Yi-jin, he volunteers for a special documentary project.

translations.value: As Yu-rim's perspective on Hee-do shifts, so does her behavior. While Hee-do avoids seeing Yi-jin, he volunteers for a special documentary project.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.plot: Under the guise of work, Yi-jin takes Hee-do and Yu-rim on a weekend getaway to the ocean — and agrees to let Ji Seung-wan and Ji-woong tag along.

translations.value: Under the guise of work, Yi-jin takes Hee-do and Yu-rim on a weekend getaway to the ocean — and agrees to let Ji Seung-wan and Ji-woong tag along.

episodes.name: Episode 11
episodes.plot: Hee-do grows upset when her career-obsessed mother fails to keep a promise. Yi-jin helps out Ji-woong's plans for a grand gesture at a music festival.

translations.value: Hee-do grows upset when her career-obsessed mother fails to keep a promise. Yi-jin helps out Ji-woong's plans for a grand gesture at a music festival.

episodes.name: Episode 12
episodes.plot: Unable to hold back from putting an end to a teacher's abusive behavior, Seung-wan stands her ground. Hee-do and Yu-rim support a distraught teammate.

translations.value: Unable to hold back from putting an end to a teacher's abusive behavior, Seung-wan stands her ground. Hee-do and Yu-rim support a distraught teammate.

episodes.name: Episode 13
episodes.plot: Warnings about allowing his personal ties to affect his work weigh heavily on Yi-jin. The school fencing team enters their last competition together.

translations.value: Warnings about allowing his personal ties to affect his work weigh heavily on Yi-jin. The school fencing team enters their last competition together.

episodes.name: Episode 14
episodes.plot: Shouldering the burdens of a sudden misfortune in her family, Yu-rim arrives at a decision that places her in hot water with the public.

translations.value: Shouldering the burdens of a sudden misfortune in her family, Yu-rim arrives at a decision that places her in hot water with the public.

episodes.name: Episode 15
episodes.plot: Hee-do once again finds herself opposite her most formidable opponent. Yi-jin is busier than ever after transferring to another department.

translations.value: Hee-do once again finds herself opposite her most formidable opponent. Yi-jin is busier than ever after transferring to another department.

episodes.name: Episode 16
episodes.plot: In an emotionally charged exchange, Hee-do and Yi-jin confront the state of their relationship. Hee-do accidentally leaves her diary on a bus.

translations.value: In an emotionally charged exchange, Hee-do and Yi-jin confront the state of their relationship. Hee-do accidentally leaves her diary on a bus.

translations.overview: Kim Tae-ri (“Mr. Sunshine”) e Nam Joo-hyuk (“Start-Up”) si tuffano negli anni ’90 in questa serie romantica sui grandi sogni e sulle problematiche della crescita.

translations.title: Twenty Five Twenty One
translations.overview: In a time when dreams seem out of reach, a teen fencer pursues big ambitions and meets a hardworking young man who seeks to rebuild his life.
translations.tagline: When we were 18, we first called each other by name. At 21, we fell in love.

translations.title: 스물다섯 스물하나
translations.overview: 꿈은 그저 꿈으로만 남을 것 같던 그 시절. 야심 찬 목표를 향해 달려가던 고등학교 펜싱선수가 무너진 삶을 다시 세우려 억척스럽게 살아가는 청년을 만난다.

overview.value: In un periodo in cui i sogni sembrano irraggiungibili, una giovane spadaccina segue le proprie ambizioni e incontra un giovane stacanovista che cerca di rifarsi una vita.
